description: This file defines a trait MultipartUploadingTrait used in AWS SDK for PHP to handle multipart uploads to S3, including managing upload state, handling results, and configuring upload parameters.

methods.name: getStateFromService
methods.description: Creates an UploadState object by querying S3 using the client to list parts of a multipart upload and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a part upload, extracting ETag and checksum data, and marks the part as uploaded in the state.

methods.name: extractETag
methods.description: Abstract method for extracting the ETag from a result, to be implemented by the class using this trait.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Prepares the complete parameters for completing multipart upload, including info on uploaded parts.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Calculates and validates the part size for multipart upload, ensuring it follows AWS size constraints.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Prepares the parameters needed to initiate a multipart upload, including ACL and ContentType.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the upload state, to be implemented by the class using this trait.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve configuration for upload, to be implemented by the class using this trait.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Abstract method to provide the size of the source data for upload.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the MIME type of the source data.
